newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Protest vessels returned from disputed islands.
Near 300,000 jobless in August, highest in decade.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Justice Department to crack down on organized crimes in stock market.
Seventeen Japanese patrol ships repulse protesters near disputed islands.
CENTRAL DAILY NEWS - Ceiling on foreign ownership of Taiwan stocks to be raised.
Justice Department forms special unit to probe organized crime in stock market.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central Bank plans no credit ease in face of rising unemployment.
